criterion.statement: A pdf_formula composition is MISLABELLED when its character content is running text rather than mathematical or symbolic material. The judgement is made on the composition's characters alone, using only font, unicode-category and geometric signals. No publication, page, paragraph identifier or literal string of any sample takes part.
criterion.evaluated_on: each PdfParagraphComposition whose pdf_formula is set, as written by StylesAndFormulas

layout_formula.why: the layout model is a detector independent of StylesAndFormulas; when it has independently called the region a formula, this criterion defers to it

precise_math_font.why: that pattern names actual mathematics typefaces (STIX Math, Latin Modern Math, TeX Gyre ... Math). Text set in them is mathematics by construction

corner_mark.why: measured, not assumed. The corner-mark rule is a font-size-ratio mechanism, not evidence about content: it fires both on genuine superscripts and on ordinary small-caps running text, where the full-size initial makes every following letter look like a corner mark. Exempting it would have excused a whole class of mislabel. Content decides instead.

vertical.why: rotated text is still text; the rotation says how it is set on the page, not what it is

min_word_len.means: the composition holds a maximal run of at least this many unicode letters
min_word_len.why: mathematics names its variables in one to three characters, and its function names (sin, cos, log, exp, tan, max) are three. Four is the first length at which a run is a word of a language rather than a symbol of a notation. Chosen above the longest function name, not fitted to any sample.

max_math_ratio.means: share of non-space characters in unicode categories Sm, Sk, Mn, Co, or in the Greek block, must not exceed this
max_math_ratio.why: one genuine mathematical symbol is enough to make a run of letters part of a notation. The bound is set just above zero so that a composition carrying any real mathematics is left alone.

min_letter_ratio.means: share of non-space characters that are unicode letters must be at least this
min_letter_ratio.why: secondary guard, so that a long letter run embedded in mostly numeric material is not read as prose.

criterion.verdict_rule: MISLABEL if and only if: no exemption holds, AND longest_letter_run >= min_word_len, AND math_ratio <= max_math_ratio, AND letter_ratio >= min_letter_ratio

known_boundary_misses.statement: cases the criterion does not flag although the text is ordinary. Recorded here rather than repaired, because the thresholds were fixed before any measurement was taken and moving them afterwards is what this batch's plan forbids.
known_boundary_misses.short_fragments: the rotated credits are cut into compositions of two and three letters, which fall under min_word_len and so are not each flagged, although the longer fragments of the same credit are
known_boundary_misses.one_symbol_is_enough: a composition of ordinary words carrying a single character in a mathematical category is exempted by max_math_ratio
